'''Aquinton Ficnan''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a member of [[Clan Ha'rangir]]. He participated in the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and was killed in the combat.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
